panels.title: Response language proxies (0–1)
panels.description: Automated lexical indicators only: empathy-language cues, actionability cues, grounded-language cues, and catastrophic wording. These are not validated measures of empathy, clinical quality, safety, or treatment outcomes and cannot establish that CogniLoop's guided response is better.

panels.title: Paired proxy delta (guided minus raw)
panels.description: Each point compares the guided and raw text from the same synthetic query. Positive values mean more cue matches for empathy/actionability/grounded wording; negative values are preferable for catastrophic wording.

options.content: **Exploratory engineering signals, not clinical evidence.** The raw Gemini answer and CogniLoop guided answer are paired on each synthetic query. The score panel counts wording cues; it does not understand context, therapeutic fit, truth, empathy quality, or harm. A higher actionability/empathy proxy or lower catastrophic-language proxy is only a hypothesis to review. The current guided path combines a contextual cognitive prompt/engine with a quantum-inspired state model; it is not a quantum-trained model. Use blinded review by qualified clinicians and a prespecified rubric before making quality or efficacy claims. `raw_simulated` means a live Gemini raw response was unavailable; `guided_fallback` means the cognitive engine supplied the final answer.
